title: The daily AI cost budget is one shared singleton wired into every provider-reaching endpoint, and the principal comes from the Spring Security context

criteria.given: the budget is declared as a singleton bean and injected into aiQueryResource
criteria.then: a wired-context test proves the third ask from one user answers 429 with the budget reason while another user is unaffected

criteria.given: the token ceilings and the chain-concurrency cap
criteria.then: they are enforced against the shared singleton across request boundaries (a wired Spring context test, not a hand-built resource)
each endpoint runs the budget gate (tryStartCall) before its provider call

criteria.given: the budget and the per-minute limiter identity
criteria.then: both resolve the caller from the Spring Security context first, and a test proves two users behind one address get separate buckets
it documents the singleton coverage of the four endpoints, the principal-first identity, and the unpriced-charge gaps on /ai/ossie/ask and /ai/explain
